GetForegroundWindow req.apiset: ext-ms-win-ntuser-window-l1-1-0 (introduced in Windows 8) --- # GetForegroundWindow function ## -description Retrieves a handle to the foreground window (the window with which the user is currently working). The system assigns a slightly higher priority to the thread that creates the foreground window than it does to other threads. ## -returns Type: HWND The return value is a handle to the foreground window. The foreground window can be NULL in certain circumstances, such as when a window is losing activation. ## -see-also Conceptual Reference SetForegroundWindow Windows
